purpose: Separate hard closed-loop safety facts, actor-grounded near-miss evidence, and utility costs while the uncertainty-aware policy is developed.

hard_endpoints: pedestrian, vehicle, and layout collision count and rate
red-light, stop-sign, route-deviation, and outside-lane infractions
eligible terminal route completion and composed score
actor_grounded_safety_margin: time exposed below OBB-TTC thresholds of 1, 2, 3, and 5 seconds
hazard response latency and braking onset
post-encroachment time when a conflict-zone trajectory supports it
utility_and_false_positive_cost: time below 0.25 m/s and below 1 m/s
unnecessary stopping outside genuine conflict intervals

metric_validity_rules: TTC and clearance must come from per-frame actor geometry, not image-plane distance or speed response alone.
The primary TTC uses fixed-orientation oriented bounding boxes; circumscribed-disc TTC is a conservative diagnostic only.
Record raw ego and actor position, velocity, yaw, and planar extent so every derived safety metric can be recomputed offline.
Require safety telemetry on every real control frame used in an official paired comparison.
Report low-TTC exposure together with completion and unnecessary-stop costs; an always-slow policy is not a selective safety improvement.
Surrogate safety-margin metrics can support overall distributional improvement but cannot replace all hard collision or serious-infraction cases.

hard_case_target.development_goal: Obtain at least three independent route-scenario cases in which a valid clean baseline is safe, a held-out observation degradation produces an official collision or serious violation, and an uncertainty-aware response reduces the hard failure without invalid completion or indiscriminate stopping.
hard_case_target.expansion_rule: Establish the clean/degraded/oracle mechanism on one case at a time before adding seeds or routes; only then estimate rates across repeated seeds.
hard_case_target.independence_preference: Prefer different towns and scenario families over several variants of the same route or corruption.

limitations: The intervention is transient full-front camera dropout and therefore belongs to the pipeline/mechanism tier, not the final external-validity tier.
The safe responses use an external bounded governor; they do not show that fine-tuned ORION learned task relevance.
The legacy runs predate the current Epic-quality and actor-telemetry protocol and must not be pooled numerically with new formal runs without an explicit compatibility rerun.
The 0.4-second response difference is not an exact TTC measurement.
This event becomes safety-margin evidence only if the actor-instrumented rerun shows worse OBB-TTC, low-TTC exposure, clearance, or conflict timing.
No governor, learned-UQ, off-path, or no-hazard conclusion is authorized yet.

next_hard_case_shortlist.reason: Held-out transfer of the Route146 crossing mechanism with a compact blocker-mediated actor region.
A moving vehicle crosses the ego conflict zone and can yield a vehicle-collision hard endpoint.
The Epic runtime and clean completion are already validated; a moving cut-in vehicle provides a second collision family.
Higher-speed bicycle encroachment is likely to produce measurable TTC degradation under a short localized observation loss.

claim_boundary: Before Stage-2 policy training succeeds, describe oracle and learned-signal governor results as operational risk-response evidence. Do not claim that ORION or the VLM understands uncertainty or task relevance.
